voice.brief: Curators, long ago people built new towns all across the West. Visit one in VR, then record a short video for me.
voice.step1: Before your headset, read about the place. Then press Practice and say your two sentences before the timer ends.
voice.step2: Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type the map word, click the map, then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Move with the thumbstick. Walk down the main street. Look at the buildings and the train tracks.
voice.step4: Open Library, then Camera. Click Record video and say your two sentences. Click again to stop. Then send it on the Canvas tab.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open the Canvas assignment and check that your video is there.
voice.extra: Have more time? Turn slowly while you record, so I can see the whole main street.

vr.look: The West is the biggest region. It has the Rocky Mountains, deserts, forests, Alaska and Hawaii. Long ago, people came west to farm, ranch, look for gold and build railroads.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Western in Filter environments. Click Western Town, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the town
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Walk down the main street. Look at the buildings and the train.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until the street and the buildings fit.

Click Record video. Say your 2 sentences. Click it again to stop.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Record a new video and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Turn slowly while you record, so Opti sees the whole main street.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, that shows the town while you say both sentences.

studio.title: Which One Does Not Belong?
studio.look: Four rounds. Each round shows four museum cards about the West and the Southwest. Three cards belong together. One does not.
studio.do: Read the question. Tap the card that does NOT belong.

game.miss: That one belongs. Look for the card from a different region.
game.done: Four rounds done! The West and the Southwest each have their own land and work.

rounds.q: Three of these are in the West. Which one is NOT?
rounds.why: it is in New York Harbor, in the Northeast.
rounds.ok: Yes! The Statue of Liberty is in the Northeast.

rounds.ok: Yes! Maple sap time belongs to the Northeast.

rounds.ok: Yes! Lobster fishing in Maine is Northeast work.
